title: Win the inner field first
summary: Conquering the mind matters more than conquering the world around you. Conquer the mind where the world first enters.
takeaway: Conquer the mind where the world first enters.
lifeApplication: When another person becomes your battlefield, bring attention back to the mind that must be conquered first.

source.shortMeaning: Conquering the mind matters more than conquering the world around you.
source.lifeApplication: Return your attention from other people to the state of your own mind.
